sloka: सो ऽहं वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्त्रीणि महावने ।तप्त्वा सुदुष्करं प्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकमनुत्तमम् ।। ७.७८.१० ॥
transliteration: so 'haṁ varṣasahasrāṇi tapastrīṇi mahāvane ।taptvā suduṣkaraṁ prāpto brahmalokamanuttamam ।। 7.78.10 ॥

translations.english: Having performed very difficult penance for three thousand years in the great forest, I attained the unsurpassed world of Brahma.
